Powered Melee Kills and Finishers grant Nightmare Fuel for 7 seconds. <strand/>Grapple Melees do not count.

Gaining or Nightmare Fuel <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine of all stowed weapons from reserves.

Nightmare Fuel grants ? Handling and 50 Airborne Effectiveness while active.

Readying a different weapon after gaining Nightmare Fuel refreshes its duration and grants <pve 35% /> <pvp [20%] /> increased weapon damage (<link Empowering Buff [#DamageBuffs] />). Swapping weapons again removes Nightmare Fuel.

Scoring a Kill with a weapon currently benefiting from the damage buff grants you a fresh instance of Nightmare Fuel (as if you scored another Powered Melee Kill).

Nightmare Fuel's damage buff is currently being overridden by both <solar/>Radiant and <solar/>Well of Radiance.
